reason: Intentional breaking change: SubgraphResult is keyed by (kind, id) instead of node id, so two same-id nodes of different kinds can both be returned. The id-keyed nodes/adjacency/reverseAdjacency maps are replaced by plain nodes and edges arrays, with (kind, id) lookups in the indexSubgraph() helper. SubgraphResult is produced by TypeGraph, not authored by consumers; listed under Breaking in the changeset.
